== English errata comparison sources ==
The Players Committee added “total” to the weapon destiny modifier and moved “character” after “just hit.” The 1998 Glossary on PDF page 26 gives the ruling on total weapon destiny. The 2022 Appendix entry continues across PDF pages 102 and 103 and retains the Levitation Attack option.

Aglets, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1322117#p1322117 Current Rulings and Errata], Players Committee, 25 November 2020. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=105|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 105. [[:File:CC-L-blasterproficiency.gif|Full errata face]].
